description: Picture sheets for paprika-make's brief, and which image and 3D model keys this machine has. `check: true` names the keys found (never a value), the running jobs and, once the project has a BRIEF.md, what it and its sheets lack; `pictures` with no provider composes a free sheet in Chrome (refs/sheets/LOOK.png, or `out`); `provider` and `prompt` make a look board, or start a turnaround or GLB model job, billed to the person's key. Details: skills/paprika-make/sheets.md.

check.description: Name the keys found, the recommendations, the jobs and, for a project with a brief, what the brief and its sheets lack (read from the project's files); nothing is made or sent.

height.description: With rig: the character's height in metres, 1.7 by default.

kind.description: look (free) without a provider; board, turnaround or model with one.

model.description: With a provider: a model other than the table's.

name.description: With a provider: the file's name.

notes.description: One line under the free sheet.

out.description: The free sheet's .png or .jpg under cwd.

palette.description: #rrggbb swatches, each with an optional name.

pictures.description: Files under cwd, each with an optional crop [left, top, right, bottom] and label.

prompt.description: With a provider: what to make.

remember.description: "yes" keeps the person's yes to picture sheets across projects; "ask" forgets it.

rig.description: With kind model and a provider that rigs (meshy): once the model lands, bind a skeleton to it and add walk and run clips (<name>-rigged.glb, <name>-walk.glb, <name>-run.glb), for a humanoid character.

name: sheet
